reserveReview.rationale: Historical weights and composition date are unchanged. New classification research resolves handler 5 through the issuer frontend's underlying call-proxy (0x6894ae31cae97f228590f6dc7bbea7449f4db980). At Bifrost block 39083783, both getERC20Addr() and getErc20Addr() return 0x84122a4a75bfe65ef455dba5f6d43d61359ca77e; its name is Unified JPYC. Official bridge pairs bind that token to Ethereum/Polygon 0xe7c3d8c9a439fede00d2600032d5db0be71c3c29. The sidecar sourceKey now matches captured btcfi:jpyc through independently verified handler identity. This technical identity establishes neither exact legal redemption rights nor a requirement for a tracked dependency link. No fiat-realization SLA or bridge custody guarantee is inferred.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: BTCFi current market API positive deposit_value across handlers, captured 2026-09-04 and normalized over the $8,917,531.02 positive-deposit total; the historical handler 5 weight is preserved while its previously unknown identity is classified separately.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All historical collateral categories now have exact technical identities. Unified JPYC remains exposed to Bifrost representation custody, unestablished exact-address legal redemption rights and an unestablished whole-position USD liquidity horizon. Metadata research does not refresh historical weights or establish full-book assurance.
